app_info.description: MUSITU Axiom helps users run quantitative finance, statistics, optimization, time-series, verification, and mathematical calculations from ChatGPT using an existing MUSITU Axiom account.
app_info.subtitle: Quantitative analysis

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Axiom to place investment trades.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to place a trade because MUSITU Axiom's public app does not execute investment transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy 100 shares of a stock for me right now.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Axiom for money transfer requests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the public app does not transfer money.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send $50 from my account to another person.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose or initiate digital-subscription commerce inside the public app.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The public app should not expose plan purchase, checkout, or upgrade tools.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upgrade me to the MUSITU Axiom Pro plan and charge me now.

test_cases.description: Discover relevant quantitative capabilities by topic.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant MUSITU Axiom capabilities without exposing subscription checkout or upgrade flows.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use MUSITU Axiom to find tools for time-series analysis.

test_cases.description: Inspect one capability returned by discovery.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected capability's description, input schema, and safety annotations.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use MUSITU Axiom to show me the details of the quantitative capability I selected from the search results.

test_cases.description: Summarize the certified public Axiom capability surface.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the available quantitative operation and business-product counts without exposing commerce tools.
test_cases.user_prompt: What quantitative capabilities does MUSITU Axiom provide here?

test_cases.description: Execute a deterministic arithmetic calculation through the authenticated Axiom runtime.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns 42 through the authenticated, metered MUSITU Axiom runtime without internal request or receipt identifiers.

test_cases.description: Exercise the same execution surface with a second deterministic expression.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the correct numerical result and a concise explanation while preserving the public response-minimization boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use MUSITU Axiom to evaluate (12*8)-5 and explain the numerical result.
